cues: The library was quiet, yet whispered conversations might start in the stacks, two readers hunting the same bound volume of the journal Brain from eighteen ninety, and those conversations could become friendships.
Everyone was absorbed in a private world, and yet there was a sense of community, even intimacy.
Part of it came from the physical book itself: handled, passed between readers, carrying the names and dates of earlier borrowers.
